Private AI that runs fully offline on one ASUS ExpertBook.

Five AI systems on a single laptop, no internet needed:
1. ERP (Odoo) running on the laptop
2. Songs from a Thai prompt
3. Chat that cites your own documents
4. Images from a Thai description
5. A voice assistant that speaks Thai

Measured on the machine with every service running: 43 tokens per second, 1.7 s to the first spoken word, 8.6 s per image, 31 s to compose a 60-second song.

A good fit for teams whose data cannot leave the building.

AI Transformation: bring AI into the whole company in 90 days.

The plan runs 13 weeks in 6 phases, with a review with management at the end of each month:
1. Prepare (weeks 1-2): set up the team and announce the AI policy
2. Survey (weeks 3-5): interview the heads of each business function
3. Set goals (weeks 6-7): 3 to 5 goals per function, with a baseline
4. Select (week 8): approve the first quick wins
5. Build (weeks 9-12): deliver quick wins on systems you already own
6. Measure (week 13): compare with the baseline and plan the next round

It covers 5 business functions (CMO, COO, CTO, CAO, CFO) and ends with a 6-week AI Champion Challenge, where staff teams show real results on Demo Day.

DockSync: dock appointment and yard management for warehouses.

Trucks book a loading slot, drivers check in with a QR code, and the warehouse team sees every bay on one live timeline. Drivers get a mobile app with push-to-talk radio, so the gate and dock teams can talk without phone calls.

Built end to end with AI: web admin (React), driver app (React Native), API (Hono and PostgreSQL), deployed on AWS.

Live at docksync.toptierdigital.space
